background: type: solid color: "#F6F6F3" elements: - elementId: title elementType: text bounds: - 56 - 34 - 848 - 40 content: text: AI 只能靠截图，判断一页做得好不好 fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 26 lineHeight: 1.3 color: "#1C2321" align: - left - top bold: true role: title - elementId: lead elementType: text bounds: - 56 - 80 - 848 - 26 content: text: 在 PowerPoint、Google Slides 里让 AI 改页面，它往往要整页截图，再“看图审计”。 fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 16 lineHeight: 1.4 color: "#56615D" align: - left - top - elementId: shot-frame elementType: shape shapeName: rect bounds: - 56 - 126 - 420 - 248 fill: type: solid color: "#FFFFFF" border: width: 1 color: "#CBD3CF" - elementId: shot elementType: image bounds: - 62 - 132 - 408 - 236 src: "media/.huandeng-versions/c36ad119b97a82db8ae3dde5b04fd9853151f34ab4ed8b49cec5352594775961.png" sourceName: zh-CN-native-edit-overview-2x.png fit: mode: contain - elementId: shot-cap elementType: text bounds: - 56 - 382 - 420 - 40 content: text: 截图：适合人最后看一眼，但很难定位到具体对象，也很难量化“改了什么”。 fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 12 lineHeight: 1.45 color: "#7A8480" align: - left - top - elementId: code-bg elementType: shape shapeName: rect bounds: - 500 - 126 - 404 - 248 fill: type: solid color: "#1F2A27" - elementId: code elementType: text bounds: - 516 - 138 - 380 - 228 content: text: |- elements: - elementId: title role: title content: text: 持续打磨同一份作品 fontSize: 26 - elementId: lead bounds: [56, 80, 848, 26] fontFamily: Consolas fontSize: 13 lineHeight: 1.55 color: "#DCE6E1" align: - left - top - elementId: code-cap elementType: text bounds: - 500 - 382 - 404 - 40 content: text: 同一页的结构：agent 可以按对象定位、检查边界、比较前后差异。 fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 12 lineHeight: 1.45 color: "#7A8480" align: - left - top - elementId: conclusion elementType: text bounds: - 56 - 432 - 848 - 40 content: text:

所以需要一种更好的 slides 文件格式。截图仍然有用，但它不该是 AI 理解页面的唯一方式。

fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 17 lineHeight: 1.5 color: "#3E4845" align: - left - top - elementId: ft-mark elementType: image bounds: - 56 - 505 - 16 - 16 src: "media/.huandeng-versions/6b49274a35445235b8ab17f805b83cf3c7f8924630a5ce5ef8455e59aba5faef.png" sourceName: huandeng.png fit: mode: contain - elementId: ft-label elementType: text bounds: - 78 - 505 - 420 - 16 content: text: HUANDENG / 为什么要做 fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 11 lineHeight: 1.3 color: "#7A8480" align: - left - middle - elementId: ft-pos elementType: text bounds: - 824 - 505 - 80 - 16 content: text: "0" fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 11 lineHeight: 1.3 color: "#7A8480" align: - right - middle field: main-position notes: 第三个原因。我之前让 AI 去做 Google Slides 或 PowerPoint 的时候发现，有时你需要让它按视觉去查看效果。它每次可能要做一个全图截屏，再去审计这一页做得怎么样。这件事在我看来是不可优化、不可数据化、不可量化的。所以一个更好的 slides 文件格式可能会更好。右边是同一页在幻灯里的结构片段：每个对象有自己的 ID、角色和位置，AI 可以精确定位、做边界检查、比较修改前后。截图仍然是最后审阅的好工具，只是不该是唯一的入口。
